projects.description:
Financial Model of Mahindra & Mahindra
• • •
Performed valuation of Mahindra & Mahindra using DCF and Multiples method for stock recommendation. Forecasted the financial line items based on assumptions from annual report and quarterly conference calls. Financial modelling involved collecting data from SIAM, TMA and industry reports by research agencies. Incorporated different scenarios based on expected industry growth rate for different product lines.

Conducted end-to-end trade lifecycle data analysis via SQL (ELT) for CSDR fee to identify process gaps, document
business requirements, and recommend actionable solutions improving STP rates, driving ~15% efficiency.
Translated BRD into functional specifications (FRD) and actionable 25+ user stories for a SaaS based tokenization
platform, defining acceptance criteria for QA validation, while maintaining requirements traceability on confluence.
Mapped end-to-end tokenization lifecycle process workflow and swimlane maps in Figma capturing decision nodes
system triggers, and exception handling paths accelerating business readiness, supporting UI/UX transformation.

tracking via Jira — achieving 98% defect closure rate within timelines ensuring zero critical defects at go-live.

system capabilities for a secure digital asset custody platform supporting crypto transactions on blockchain infra using
AI tools, drove comprehensive risk mitigation by engineering a 3x3 risk rating matrix with more than 30 attributes.
Delivered a multi-region tokenization platform (MALT) product development along 4 different product by training
a 15-member team on procedure documentation, , ensuring 100% operational readiness and seamless Agile delivery.
Monitored trade execution and settlement projections to generate liquidity forecasts, ensuring funding optimization.
Partnered with brokers and custodians to resolve multi-million-dollar OTC derivative trade breaks, minimizing risks.
Collaborated with Trade Operations to facilitate the setup of various securities on APL and TNET (Trustnet)
Maintained SOP documentation for trade settlement and reconciliation for different Securities & Derivatives.
Generate comprehensive manual pricing reports across Bloomberg, IDC, and other custodian platforms (Fidelity,
Pershing) to provide high-fidelity inputs for asset modelling, ensuring accurate daily NAV and robust risk mitigation.
Led a research vertical for 12 members to deliver weekly sector modules for "Vittlitt" strategic content, analysing
Projects and Internships
